# Incompatible API changes accepted since the latest v* tag, one per line,
# exactly as the "exported API is compatible with the latest tag" step in
# .github/workflows/test.yml prints them, e.g.
#
#   - ./protocol.AssessCompatibility: removed
#
# That step fails a PR on any incompatible change apidiff reports against the
# latest tag unless it is listed here. When a break is intended, list it in the
# same PR, so it is reviewed as a decision instead of found by a consumer after
# the tag is cut. Empty the list once the next tag is cut: it describes the
# difference from the latest tag, and the step reports entries that no longer
# differ.
